definition.name: budget-active-set
definition.question: How do active constraints differ from positive shadow prices?
definition.formula: min 0.5*||w-(2,1)||^2, w>=0, w1+w2<=tau; exact piecewise coordinate and multiplier formulas from ex:opt-kkt-budget
definition.sampling: 801 uniform points on [0,4], including both switches; tau=0 shown only as the right-limit extension, chapter example assumes tau>0.
definition.design: Two aligned panels share budget x axis and y range; coordinate/multiplier roles explicit in titles; dotted references are switch locations.
